organization.name: Elastic N.V.
organization.notes: Independent Dutch public company Elastic N.V.; current 2026 results and investor FAQ confirm NYSE ESTC. Official company history says founded 2012; Elasticsearch project predates company. Historical private investors Index, Benchmark, SVAngel, NEA; current holdings not asserted.

pricingTiers.name: Standard
pricingTiers.notes: As low as $99/month. Footnote: production configuration with 120 GB storage across 2 zones, instance-type usage pricing. Actual region/provider/capacity/add-ons change cost; no annual total inferred.
No public designation or verified amount found in reviewed pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Gold
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational tier above Standard; as low as$114/month for footnoted 120 GB/two-zone production configuration. Adds reporting and third-party alerts; not a Business-named plan. Usage-based instance cost, not an all-inclusive fixed bill.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: As low as$184/month for footnoted 120 GB/two-zone production configuration; instance-type usage pricing and additional feature charges apply. Annual total not published. Sales custom contracts separate.

moats.claim: Elastic query/API ecosystem and integrations create accumulated application compatibility and expertise that can raise replacement costs.

productReasons.claim: Keyword/vector retrieval plus inference/reranking supports both traditional search and AI retrieval.
Kibana exploration and dashboards connect indexed data to interactive investigation.
Serverless separates search and ingest compute so workloads can be tuned independently.
